title: Ladder 13 · Sāpō prō sociīs (soap for the partners)
summary: Gaius promised the island partners that Marcus would hand over Livia's never-ready slide today; wind sends the plane backwards, the purse vanishes, three dollars buy soap, and Tullia's minutes save the deal (and reveal who had the purse all along).
